name: Weak/NULL/EXPORT cipher suites in TLS config
attack_scenario: Attacker negotiates an EXPORT or anonymous suite and either brute-forces the 40-bit key (FREAK) or performs a full MITM because an aNULL suite skips server authentication entirely.
negative_test_hint: offer only "EXP-RC4-MD5" in the TLS ClientHello and assert the server refuses the handshake rather than negotiating the weak suite

exemplar.explanation: RC4 (biased keystream), MD5 MACs (collisions), EXPORT-grade suites (FREAK/Logjam), DES-CBC3 (SWEET32), and anonymous suites (aNULL/eNULL/ADH, no server authentication, so full MITM) are all cryptographically broken. A hardened cipher string restricted to modern AEAD suites with explicit exclusions leaves the attacker no weak suite to negotiate.
